assay_or_perturbation: TNC EGF-like repeat exposure; EGFR phosphorylation; ERK and mitogenesis/adhesion assays
evidence_summary: TNC EGF-like repeats were associated with EGFR activation, ERK-MAPK signaling and mitogenic/adhesion outputs.
limitations: No terminal TF or SCI-specific output was established.

assay_or_perturbation: L1CAM-EGFR association; RTK phosphorylation; MAPK and neurite-adhesion assays
evidence_summary: L1CAM was associated with EGFR cis/trans interaction, RTK phosphorylation and neurite/adhesion signaling.
limitations: The study does not assign a terminal TF target or SCI-specific receiver-cell state.

assay_or_perturbation: E-cadherin/N-cadherin binding; cell-cell adhesion and force-transmission assays
evidence_summary: E-cadherin/N-cadherin interactions were associated with heterophilic adhesion and force transmission.
limitations: No terminal TF or direct cadherin-to-RTK molecular edge was assigned.
